text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An earsplitting roar rises from the crowd,
echoing
through the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
These cheers are for no one else but
Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: That was amazing, Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for that incredible
performance! That
was some race... A
race so exciting, I'll never
forget it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeehaaaw! I really appreciate all the
support!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Did ya see that, Trainer? I'm number
one! The
King of the Mile!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You were the first person to believe in
me...I did
it... with these... these legs!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sniff...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! This is no time to turn on the
waterworks!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If I start blubberin' now, I'll miss out on
those
smiles...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yours and everybody else's!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Cheers.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Great job out there, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thanks! You too, Suzuka. Great job!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Honestly, this is frustrating. I truly, truly gave this race everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I came nowhere close to your
speed...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank ya, Suzuka. You really are... my
best friend.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Taiki...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Just so you know, I won't be giving up.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I have what it takes to surpass you. I'll
go beyond
speed itself.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So we have to run together again...
Promise me
we will.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Of course, what're friends for? Now, get
on in
here!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
P-please... no hugs. This habit of yours is
a little
suffocating at times...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whaddya mean?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle has continued to ace her
races with
perfect results.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's conquered the Yasuda Kinen, the
Sprinters
Stakes, and the Mile
Championship.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's even taken down Silence Suzuka,
the
strongest Umamusume around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle has what it takes to be a
star of her
time—no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Darn tootin'!
choice_data_list: Let's definitely become Uma Musume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just sit tight and watch me bring my
dream to
life, Trainer!
